content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question regarding network projects. When I add a new [product_name] with [version_no], the interface automatically opens with the Logic Diagram Editor (FDB), even though I set the Ladder Diagram Editor as default in the options. This seems to prevent uploading an existing ladder diagram directly. Is there a way to do this, or is it necessary to convert the diagram to FDB before loading it?
No, programming in ladder mode is only supported in diagram mode, not when working within network project mode.

However, in diagram mode you can convert a ladder diagram to an FBD diagram, save the FBD diagram, and then import it in a network project. But after conversion, the blocks are arranged randomly and this makes the diagram highly confusing.
That's why I was hoping there was an option to import the ladder editor directly. Anyway, thanks for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that direct import or usage of ladder diagrams in network project mode within the [product_name] software is not possible, even when preferences are set to the Ladder Diagram Editor. The suggested workaround is to convert ladder diagrams to logic diagrams (FDB), but users find the converted diagrams to be disorganized and difficult to use, which lowers overall clarity and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to upload and use ladder diagrams directly within network project mode and to work consistently in the ladder editor as specified in software preferences.
pain_keywords: missing ladder support in network projects
